summary: This directory is dedicated to the testing of analysis logic related to file-based symbol resolution. It serves to verify the mechanisms responsible for identifying and extracting exported symbols from source files within the project analysis pipeline.
responsibilities: Verify the accuracy of finding export symbols in source files
Validate logic for parsing and resolving module exports
relationships: The analysis logic processes source files to identify export symbols.
Unit tests validate that the export symbol identification correctly interprets code structures.
designDecisions: Colocation of test files within the module they verify
Isolation of analysis logic for independent testing
